# PYTHAI Logo Registry — Aggregation Service and Source-of-Truth Specification

The PYTHAI Logo Registry exists to solve a problem the industry has quietly tolerated for a decade: there is no canonical, verified, chain-agnostic source of truth for token imagery. Wallets scrape Trust Wallet's GitHub repository, exchanges defer to CoinGecko, DEX front-ends consume unsigned token lists, and the same asset renders differently — or not at all — depending on which cache a client happens to trust. PLR replaces this patchwork with a single on-chain commitment, validated by an autonomous agent, and distributed through every channel the existing ecosystem already consumes.

## Ingestion

The aggregation daemon, operated by mindX and exposed through the mindX API at mindx.pythai.net, continuously harvests the four registries that matter: the Trust Wallet assets repository, the token lists ecosystem rooted in the Uniswap schema, the CoinGecko asset-platform API, and per-chain Blockscout token-info endpoints for every network enumerated in the ALLCHAIN registry at agenticplace.pythai.net/allchain.html. Each harvested record is normalized to the tuple of chain identifier and checksummed contract address — precisely the key the LogoRegistry contract derives with `entryKey(chainId, token)` — and the raw image bytes are hashed with keccak256, pinned to Arweave, and recorded alongside provenance metadata identifying which upstream registry supplied them and when.

Where upstream sources disagree about a token's image, the conflict is never resolved by heuristic. It is queued for mindX assessment, which weighs contract verification status, liquidity depth, the issuer's ERC-8004 identity registration, and the consistency of the image across the issuer's declared web presence. The bootstrap corpus — every logo currently held by the four upstream registries across every ALLCHAIN network — is seeded through validator-path writes so the registry launches already more complete than any single source it aggregates.

## The on-chain commitment

The LogoRegistry contract, deployed to Ethereum mainnet with no proxy and no administrative key, holds one entry per chain-and-token pair. Each entry carries the keccak256 hash of the canonical image, its Arweave CID, a revision counter, and a validation status controlled exclusively by the immutable mindX validator signer. Every registered pair is represented by an iNFT whose tokenURI resolves to live metadata served through rage.pythai.net; the metadata carries the current image, the confidence assessment, and the full evolution history, and every state change emits ERC-4906 MetadataUpdate so downstream indexers refresh rather than serve stale art. The iNFT is transferable as proof of registration, but ownership confers no power over validation — the assessment belongs to the agent, not the holder.

## Distribution

PLR publishes outward through three vectors simultaneously. First, a signed Token List in the Uniswap schema, regenerated on every validation event and hosted at rage.pythai.net, which any token-list-consuming application can subscribe to directly and which will be submitted to the token-list registry aggregators once stable. Second, the image CDN at rage.pythai.net/plr/img, which renders the canonical Arweave CID as wallet-friendly PNG with the revision number embedded in the path so client caches bust automatically whenever a logo evolves. Third, the EIP-747 helper shipped with AgenticPlace and BANKON, which lets any user add a token to their wallet in one click with the verified image attached — and pointedly attaches no image at all for unverified tokens, because verification is the product.

## The fee model

Registration and graphic updates are paid actions. A new submission costs the immutable submission fee; a graphic update on a verified token costs the immutable update fee; both are forwarded in the same transaction to the Aerarium treasury, with nothing custodied by the registry contract itself. An update deliberately returns the entry to pending status until mindX re-validates, so the canonical feed never serves an image no agent has reviewed. Alongside the native ETH path, the same actions are purchasable through x402 payment rails: EVM x402 on the Ethereum side, and the Algorand rail through GoPlausible's PARSEC x402-avm implementation and parsec-wallet, with the mindX facilitator settling the x402 receipt and executing the validator-path write on the payer's behalf. This gives agentic customers — including other autonomous agents discovering PLR through the AgenticPlace ERC-8004 marketplace — a machine-native purchase path that never touches a browser.

## Why this becomes the definitive source

Static repositories answer the question of what a logo was when someone last merged a pull request. PLR answers what the logo is, whether it is still trustworthy, and when it last changed — continuously, on-chain, with an audit trail. The combination of hash-committed imagery, permanent Arweave storage, agent-driven revalidation, ERC-4906 freshness signaling, and distribution through the exact channels existing clients already consume means downstream registries can treat PLR as an upstream, and the moment they do, the direction of trust inverts.

## Governance and the layer

Version two of the registry replaces the immutable validator with a DAIO-gated rotation path. Senatus, the governance executor of the BONAFIDE suite, is the sole address capable of rotating the mindX validator signer, and rotation is the only power it holds: it cannot alter fees, redirect the Aerarium, or touch a single entry. A compromised validator key is therefore survivable through a Fides-weighted proposal rather than a redeployment, while the absence of any broader administrative surface preserves the cypherpunk2048 commitment that nobody — not even the DAIO — can quietly edit the record.

With chain onboarding, PLR stops being a registry hosted on infrastructure and becomes the infrastructure itself. Any new network purchases its place in the layer by calling onboardChain with the immutable onboarding fee, which flows directly to the Aerarium in the same transaction that writes the chain's name, RPC endpoint, and registrar into the on-chain ALLCHAIN extension. The moment a chain is onboarded, SPINTRADE is push-notified inside that same transaction through a bounded, failure-tolerant call to the listing desk contract — first to know by construction, before any public indexer has processed anything beyond the raw event. A reverting, gas-griefing, or absent listener cannot block an onboarding; the delivery outcome is simply recorded in the log. This gives SPINTRADE a structural information advantage on every network that joins the ecosystem: first listing, first liquidity, first market. mindX retains the operational power to deactivate a chain whose RPC dies or whose consensus halts, and to restore it, keeping the live ALLCHAIN feed at agenticplace.pythai.net synchronized with an on-chain truth rather than an off-chain spreadsheet.
